title: Place Record (Gazetteer)
description: A named administrative or natural area: a country, state, county, city, NWS zone, tribal area, watershed. This is the one type here that was not in the original set, added because geo.places and geo.place_closure on every other record point at these. Without it, 'everything in Travis County' has nothing to resolve against, and areas end up stored as bare points - which is exactly what the existing ATLAS file does with Texas. Build this table first; everything geographic depends on it.

category.description: `kind` is required: a place whose kind is unknown cannot be placed in the containment hierarchy.

kind.description: What sort of area this is.

adm_level.description: Depth in the administrative hierarchy: 0 country, 1 state/region, 2 county, 3 locality. Lets you query a whole tier without enumerating kinds.

boundary_source.description: Which authoritative dataset the boundary geometry came from, and its vintage.

$comment: External codes go in envelope `identifiers`, not here. Expected schemes: fips_state, fips_county, same, ugc_zone, ugc_county, iso3166_2, gnis, geonames, osm_relation. Build a (scheme, value) -> id index over all place records; that index is what lets an IPAWS SAME code, an NWS UGC zone and a geocoder string all resolve to the same record.
